title: URL Query Cross-Tier Entitlement Bypass in Canonical Audit Report
description: The audit report page previously assigned clientTier directly from the client query parameter (sp?.tier === 'basic' ? 'basic' : sp?.tier === 'pro' ? 'pro' : 'advanced'). Any unauthenticated user could append '?tier=advanced' to any contract address, or omit the parameter entirely, unlocking proprietary Advanced static analysis sections without payment or session verification.
reproductionSteps: 1. Navigate to /security/audits/report/0x<arbitrary-address>?tier=advanced. 2. Observe that advanced sections were delivered unlocked.
impact: Complete monetization and intellectual property bypass. Unauthorized exfiltration of Advanced tier static analysis, decompiled bytecode metrics, and remediation diffs.
remediation: Re-engineered report page to enforce server-side session authentication via resolveRequestAccount, getAuditCaseForOwningAccount, and verifyVlmPaidAccountEntitlement for non-benchmark contracts. If unentitled, clientTier is clamped to 'basic' and proprietary sections are strictly locked with data: null.
verificationEvidence: Headless Playwright audit verified that navigating with '?tier=advanced' on non-benchmark contract yields exactly 6 locked sections and 0 unentitled data exposure.

title: Console Error Noise on Catalog Fetch Abort During Fast Navigation
description: The catch block in fetchShieldProFullCatalogUncached unconditionally logged console.error('[FULL CATALOG CATCH ERROR]:', error) before checking if the error was caused by a standard AbortSignal or component unmount, polluting the browser console.
reproductionSteps: 1. Navigate rapidly from Shield Pro to Real Markets. 2. Inspect browser developer console. 3. Observe TypeError: Failed to fetch logged as error.
impact: Console noise, deceptive telemetry alarms, potential developer confusion during production triage.
remediation: Added pre-check for DOMException AbortError and signal.aborted before logging, removing unconditional console.error and recording pagination termination as a structured blocker string.
verificationEvidence: Live browser test verified 0 console errors across all 5 surfaces during rapid sequential navigation.

title: Free Intake Contract Displaying Paid Checkout Modal in Error State
description: Intake form previously had contradictory CTA copies between 'Free Community' (€0) and €79.99 Pro checkout buttons, occasionally surfacing checkout redirects for free tier analysis.
reproductionSteps: 1. Select Basic Tier in intake. 2. Observe conflicting €0 and €79.99 pricing badges.
impact: Customer confusion, potential cart abandonment, perceived deceptive marketing.
remediation: Harmonized all intake tiers: Basic is explicitly €0 (Free Community with instant client-side static scan), Pro is €79.99, Advanced is €399.99.
verificationEvidence: Pricing parity confirmed across SecurityAuditsCleanPage.tsx, CanonicalAuditReportView.tsx, and Stripe checkout configuration.

title: Risk of Crypto Terminology Leaking into Real Markets / TradFi Surface
description: TradFi equities and commodities quotes must maintain strict financial semantics without referencing 'gas fees', 'wallets', or 'on-chain confirmations'.
reproductionSteps: 1. Search TradFi ticker (e.g. AAPL, XAU). 2. Inspect response metadata.
impact: Institutional credibility loss if crypto slang appears in institutional equity inspection.
remediation: Enforced domain vocabulary isolation with schemaVersion 'velmere.p99.real-markets-reference-semantics.v1' and priceSemanticClass 'reference'.
verificationEvidence: Automated test suite verified zero crypto terms in TradFi responses.
